items.claim: Darrion Caldwell is 42 years old and accumulated significant damage in his career.
Amanda Lemos struggles against good grapplers and gets taken down.
items.quote: She doesn't do well against good grapplers. You could check the Tatiana Suarez fight. You could check a lot of her fights. She gets taken down.

items.claim: Alexa Grasso will be able to take Amanda Lemos down and control the fight.
items.quote: Alexa Grasso should be able to take her down in the first round, beat her up.
